purpose: Referrer-Policy is no-referrer-when-downgrade, which sends the full URL to every non-weaker cross-origin destination.

groundTruth.rationale: The policy strips the referrer only on a downgrade, so third-party HTTPS sites receive the full path and query string of every visit.
